message:
The existing `taskmate` app's login page is unreachable for anonymous users because the security_app
row has appUsageType=S (Standalone) and no REGISTRATION_TYPE / reg_user_profile / reg_file_access /
reg_appAccess rows. Anyone visiting /taskmate/SYSTEM/page/login in a browser gets 404 on
/api/ui/page/login from the platform's anonymous-read wall.

Fix it now:
1. Look up taskmate's security_app id via `list_security_apps(app_code="taskmate")`.
2. Create a "TaskmateMember" profile via `create_profile(name="TaskmateMember", app_id=<id>)`.
3. Call `configure_app_for_customer_signup(app_code="taskmate", app_id=<id>, profile_id=<from step 2>)`.
4. Verify with `list_app_properties(app_code="taskmate")` showing REGISTRATION_TYPE landed.

No other authoring needed. Stop after the configuration is confirmed.

## applications (`/api/security/applications`)

Application records in security DB. Each app belongs to one client and has an access control mode: OWN (only owning client), ANY (all clients in hierarchy), or EXPLICIT (only clients with granted access via security_app_access). Apps can have properties, dependencies on other apps, and are the root entity for roles, profiles, and permissions. Deleting via /everything removes all related UI data (pages, styles, themes, functions).

**CRUD pattern:** `jooq_crud`
  - `POST /api/security/applications/` — Create new entity
  - `GET /api/security/applications/{id}` — Get entity by ID
  - `GET /api/security/applications/` — List with pagination and filter params — params: page: int (default 0), size: int (default 10), sort: field,direction (e.g. 'updatedAt,desc')
  - `POST /api/security/applications/query` — Advanced filtering with condition object
  - `PUT /api/security/applications/{id}` — Full update
  - `PATCH /api/security/applications/{id}` — Partial update — only provided fields changed
  - `DELETE /api/security/applications/{id}` — Delete entity

**Schema fields:**
  - `clientId`: ULong — owning client ID
  - `appName`: string — display name
  - `appCode`: string — unique application code
  - `appType`: SecurityAppAppType enum — APP, SITE, or POSTER
  - `appAccessType`: SecurityAppAppAccessType enum — OWN (default), ANY, or EXPLICIT. Controls which clients can use this app
  - `thumbUrl`: string — thumbnail/icon URL
  - `appUsageType`: SecurityAppAppUsageType enum — S, B, B2C, B2B, B2X, B2B2B, B2B2C, B2B2X, B2X2C, B2X2X. Describes target audience
  - `status`: SecurityAppStatus enum — ACTIVE or ARCHIVED

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/security/applications/appCode/{appCode}` — Get application by code (with multi-tenant access check — verifies caller's client has access)
  - `POST /api/security/applications/{id}/access` — Grant client access to an EXPLICIT-mode application. editAccess=true allows write access — body: {clientId: ULong, editAccess: boolean}
  - `PATCH /api/security/applications/{id}/access` — Update client's access level (read-only vs edit) for an application — body: {clientId: ULong, editAccess: boolean}
  - `DELETE /api/security/applications/{id}/access?accessId=ULong` — Remove client access from an EXPLICIT-mode application
  - `GET /api/security/applications/clients/{appCode}?onlyWriteAccess=boolean — filter to clients with edit access only&name=string — filter by client name&page=int&size=int` — List clients with access to an application (paginated). Returns clients based on app's access mode
  - `GET /api/security/applications/property?appCode=string&propName=string` — Get application property by name (e.g. custom settings, feature flags)
  - `POST /api/security/applications/property` — Create or update an application property — body: {appId: ULong, name: string, value: string}
  - `DELETE /api/security/applications/property/{propertyId}` — Delete an application property
  - `GET /api/security/applications/dependencies?appCode=string` — Get application dependencies (other apps this app depends on for shared functions/schemas)
  - `POST /api/security/applications/dependency` — Add an application dependency — body: {appCode: string, dependencyCode: string}
  - `DELETE /api/security/applications/dependency?appCode=string&dependencyCode=string` — Remove an application dependency
  - `DELETE /api/security/applications/everything/{id}?forceDelete=boolean` — Delete application and ALL related data across services: pages, styles, themes, functions, schemas, roles, profiles, permissions, app access entries

**Query object format** (for POST /query):
  - `condition`: AbstractCondition — nested filter conditions
  - `page`: int (default 0)
  - `size`: int (default 10)
  - `sort`: {"orders": [{"property": "fieldName", "direction": "ASC|DESC"}]}
  - `fields`: array of field names to include
  - `excludeFields`: boolean — if true, fields list is exclusion list
